explanation: Mathlib has general antipode results, including `CategoryTheory.HopfObj.antipode_antipode` (in `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Hopf_.lean`), which says the antipode squares to the identity in a commutative Hopf algebra. That does not imply this idempotent is fixed. I found no Mathlib declaration establishing the fixed-point result under the finite-localization hypotheses; the target proof instead uses its library-specific `FinitePart.finitePartIdempotent_unique`.
